records.procedure: Real natural Open Mic take; save; inspect source-supported 1+1 advice; repeat on the same action; reopen exact saved review.
must_observe: Advice is supported, specific and usable; observer explains why.
A/B take and stored-feedback binding before lawful content removal; do not infer server persistence from current-view counters.
Older-take feedback remains attached to its actual take/request.

records.procedure: Real full Focus take covering the declared points; inspect coverage and advice; exercise Edit/New Set/Back/reload and repeat under the selected approved scope.
must_observe: Full useful Focus and all declared point-specific advice.
Stop/final transcript/evaluation/save ordering on selected served release.
Every attempted coaching request has an accounted terminal outcome and permitted budget.

records.procedure: Real partial Focus take with an intended subset fixed before speaking; deliberately omit another point.
must_observe: Honest partial coverage and usable next action; unspoken point remains unmarked.
Bind provisional/committed transcript and actual marker mutation to the same take/audio clock.
Preserve original deadline; late polling observation cannot identify historical mutation time.
not_proven_by: poll timestamp treated as mutation time

records.procedure: Real speaker uses natural filler hesitations and lexical negatives; compare appropriately permitted annotations with live and saved displayed counts.
must_observe: Observed filler/non-filler examples with human rationale in approved private evidence.
Correct default-tier visible availability; truthful unavailable state when unsupported.

records.procedure: Physical device, legitimate native prompt context: deny, observe truthful refusal and no recording, then use actual browser settings/Allow and follow the approved recovery flow.
must_observe: Native permission action and actual app acquisition outcome bound to the press.
No hidden live track or automatic resume; truthful controls; recovered take when authorized.
State whether recovery is the original denied page or a fresh browser. The automated same-account/fresh-browser result does not prove original-page Allow→Retry.
Private authorized residue/cleanup disposition remains separate from denial/recovery acceptance.

records.procedure: Physical supported phone: approved Stop/save/visible Practice Loop/reopen and scrolling/touch acceptance. Keep returning-user read-only navigation as a separately bound no-write observation; no recording is permitted in that read-only case.
must_observe: Actual readable/tappable essential actions on the named phone/viewport/orientation.
For separately authorized model-fault observations: exact asset/attempt and injected fault, truthful failure/Retry, no false readiness or Cloud fallback, then authorized recovery.

Returning-user case15: approved existing fixture, authenticated eligibility/completed history, baseline/final no-write counts, zero model/mic/coaching activity. Phone Stop/save must not be used as evidence of read-only no writes.
not_proven_by: canary fixture history as authenticated eligibility
